job.title: AVP - IT - Technology Risk Manager & Cyber GRC
job.description:
Regional IT Manager – Technology Risk Management (TRM) & Cyber GRC

About the role
This first-line regional role spans the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC teams, with a focus on the Middle East. It reports locally to the Head of IT, Middle East, and functionally to both EMEA teams in London. You’ll add specialist risk and control capacity alongside the existing regional team. You’ll strengthen coordination, but you won’t take over ownership from established colleagues.

Key responsibilities

  • Risk management: Identify, assess, track and close technology and cyber risks and issues. Keep a clear, decision-ready view of risks, control gaps and remediation, linked to risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
  • Controls: Support the design, testing, evidencing and improvement of controls. Spot recurring weaknesses and help owners recover overdue or Red/Amber items.
  • Regulatory compliance: Coordinate first-line responses to DORA, EBA, ECB, Middle East and Head Office requirements, and turn obligations into practical controls and actions.
  • Policy governance: Support the review, approval and exception management of technology and cyber policies and standards.
  • Metrics and reporting: Run the monthly KRI/KPI cycle, analyse trends, and prepare concise papers for the Security & Technology Risk Committee and other executive forums.
  • Audit: Act as senior first-line contact for internal and external audits. Coordinate evidence and management responses, and track findings through to closure.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Influence senior, distributed stakeholders across Technology, Cyber, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Audit, and explain complex matters in clear business language.
  • Continuous improvement: Strengthen the first-line operating model, RACI, governance routes and reporting processes.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong first-line experience in technology risk, cyber GRC, controls or assurance within a regulated environment, ideally financial services
  • A clear understanding of the first- and second-line split within an enterprise risk framework
  • Experience across infrastructure, applications, cloud, data, resilience, change and third-party risk
  • Knowledge of DORA, EBA guidance, NIST, ISO 27001 and COBIT
  • A track record coordinating regulatory, audit and remediation activity, with strong evidence discipline
  • The ability to influence without authority and to work effectively across regional and global teams

What’s on offer
Hybrid and flexible working, competitive leave, private medical, life and invalidity insurance, plus Sport & Social Clubs and D&I networks.

Thank you for your application. Only suitable candidates will be contacted.

Please note that by applying to this role, your profile may be searchable in our database. We will contact you should another suitable role become available.

job.title: Senior Programmer
job.description:
Senior Programmer | Abu Dhabi, UAE

Are you driven by solving complex technical challenges while leading teams that build solutions with real-world impact?

We’re partnering with a fast-growing renewable energy company that’s transforming lives through clean, affordable energy solutions across emerging markets. They’re now expanding their UAE operations and looking for a Senior Programmer to join their team in Abu Dhabi.

About the Role

In this role, you will lead a team of approximately 10-15 developers within a collaborative and purpose-driven engineering environment. You’ll balance hands-on technical involvement with people leadership, playing a key role in shaping software architecture, improving development processes, and ensuring systems are robust, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong leader who enjoys mentoring teams, working cross-functionally, and contributing to solutions that make a meaningful impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of around 15 software engineers
  • Architect, design, and implement high-quality software solutions using Microsoft technologies
  • Oversee code reviews, technical design decisions, and engineering best practices
  • Drive continuous improvement through process optimization and technical innovation
  • Collaborate closely with product, business, and leadership stakeholders to align technology with strategic goals
  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and maintainable across environments

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in Microsoft development environments
  • Strong hands-on expertise in MSSQL and database management
  • Proven leadership or people management experience within a technical team
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Proactive, adaptable mindset suited to a fast-paced, impact-driven organization

Why This Role?

  • Lead a sizable engineering team with real influence on technical direction
  • Work in a purpose-driven organization focused on sustainable, inclusive impact
  • Be part of a diverse and collaborative environment that values innovation and integrity

job.title: EA & Office Manager (UAEN)
job.description:
Executive Assistant/Office Manager (UAE National) | Dubai, UAE

Your Mission

Lead the setup and day-to-day management of the Abu Dhabi office, ensuring it operates efficiently and aligns with global objectives. Serve as the primary liaison with UAE government entities, oversee compliance with strategic partnerships, and drive operational excellence across the UAE hub.

You will also provide executive support to the CEO, coordinate meetings, prepare strategic documents, organize occasional travel or events, and foster a culture of integrity and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and manage the Abu Dhabi office: finalize office space, manage vendors and budgets, implement operational systems and controls.
  • Liaise with government entities and ensure compliance with partnership requirements.
  • Track operational KPIs and incentive milestones.
  • Provide executive support to the CEO: scheduling, strategic documents, and planning.
  • Build strong relationships with partners, investors, and regulators.
  • Champion operational excellence and innovation within the UAE hub.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Only UAE Nationals will be considered for this role.
  • 4+ years in executive support, office management, or operations leadership, including UAE government liaison (PRO) experience. Familiarity with government incentive programs such as ADIO is a plus.
  • B.A. in Business Administration, Management, or related field.
  • Strong project coordination, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight. Proficiency in MS 365 or Google Workspace. Excellent English and Arabic (written and verbal); and/or French a plus.
  • Attributes: Entrepreneurial mindset, cultural agility, discretion, proactivity, and passion for meaningful work.

*We kindly request that only candidates who meet all the required qualifications apply. This helps us ensure a faster and more focused recruitment process.*

job.title: TEST - Fictitious Job Posting Creator
job.description:
Job Description:
We are seeking a highly creative and self-aware individual to craft engaging and entirely made-up job postings—just like the one you're reading right now. In this role, you will be responsible for writing compelling job descriptions that openly acknowledge their own artificial nature while still maintaining a sense of professionalism and intrigue.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop detailed and realistic yet entirely fictional job postings.
  • Mention within the job description itself that it is, in fact, a fabricated listing.
  • Balance humor, creativity, and professionalism to make the reader question reality.
  • Collaborate with an imaginary hiring manager to refine job details that do not exist.
  • Ensure all qualifications and responsibilities are just plausible enough to sound real.

Qualifications:

  • Strong writing skills with the ability to craft engaging and self-referential content.
  • A keen eye for detail, even when detailing something that doesn’t exist.
  • The ability to recognize the irony in applying for a job that openly states it is fictitious.
  • Previous experience in satire, humor writing, or job postings (real or imagined) is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Unlimited PTO (because the job isn’t real).
  • A competitive salary in Monopoly money.
  • The satisfaction of knowing you've contributed to a paradox.
  • Work from anywhere… or nowhere.

If you’re interested in applying for this completely non-existent position, simply think about it really hard, and we’ll know. Alternatively, feel free to submit an application, which will be reviewed by our highly skilled team of imaginary recruiters.

We look forward to not hiring you! 🚀
